## GoogleChromeClient interface

The Google Chrome client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `googleChromeContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [GoogleChromeResources](./google-chrome_contract.googlechromeresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface GoogleChromeClient extends ClientBrand<GoogleChromeResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[GoogleChromeResources](./google-chrome_contract.googlechromeresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
